summary: Issue #94: builder-to-homeowner assessment proration inside the ownership transfer (Still Creek Ranch / Lennar only). Builder rates may be a percent of the homeowner rate; transfer_proration_builders says which builders trigger it; assessment_prorations ties each charge to the transfer, tenure, ledger row, batch and GL entry; transfer_proration_plan (read-only) and post_transfer_assessment_proration (writes a draft batch) implement the calendar-day rule and block on ambiguous builder activity; before the community has a POSTED conversion the proration is only STAGED (calculation recorded against the transfer; no ledger, batch or GL). Seeds Still Creek's $495.00 homeowner rate, 50% builder rate and the Lennar rule. No ledger, GL, tenure or ownership row changes.

preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'assessment_prorations'

preflight.name: no proration has ever been posted (the table changes shape safely)
transfer_proration_builders does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'transfer_proration_builders'

preflight.name: Still Creek has no assessment rates yet (the seed adds them)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM community_assessment_rates WHERE community_id = 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006'

expected_changes: community_assessment_rates: annual_amount_cents becomes nullable; adds pct_of_homeowner_rate (builder only, 0 < pct <= 100); a builder rate is an amount OR a percent, a homeowner rate is an amount. Adds income_account_number (default 4000) and deferral_account_number (homeowner row only): the community's revenue treatment.
Creates transfer_proration_builders (community, builder company, active), PK (community_id, builder_company_id), FKs RESTRICT. Grants SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE to service_role.

assessment_prorations: adds proposal_id, role, tenure_id, period_start/end, rate_pct, net_responsibility_cents, prior_billed_cents, homeowner_txn_id, batch_id, journal_entry_id, status, staged_plan, recognition_schedule_id (FK recognition_schedules), with FKs (RESTRICT), role/status CHECKs, a completeness CHECK when tied to a transfer, and UNIQUE (proposal_id, role).
homeowner_transactions: unique index so one transfer can never carry two proration rows of the same role. No row changes.

Functions transfer_proration_name_has (immutable), transfer_proration_plan (read-only plan), post_transfer_assessment_proration (writes a draft batch + ledger rows + audit rows after an approved transfer); the two plan/post functions are service_role only.

Seeds Still Creek Ranch: homeowner rate $495.00 (12-31 year) deferred through 2205 into 4000 (its own GL: 1/1/2026 reclass of $158,895.00 to 2205, $13,241.25 released monthly), builder rate 50% of the homeowner rate, and the Lennar rule (3 rows). No other row in any table changes.
